verdict.rationale: The README is served from the public dagster-io/dagster GitHub repository, so the source is readable. The docs also have an 'oss' deployment section, which implies an open-source edition. No evidence item names the actual license, so the 'open license' half of the story is only implied. Missing for 10: an explicit license statement (e.g. a LICENSE file or a named license such as Apache-2.0), and independent corroboration that the core is fully open source rather than partly proprietary.
